scenario: `call mqtt.publish`, which nothing in the import closure declares (only `light.turn_on` is imported), is refused with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_SERVICE (LADP.8.2.3: no match).
rules_ds:
from ha import light

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call mqtt.publish topic: "x" cooldown: 30_s

libraries.ha:
service light.turn_on:
    kwarg entity_id: String literal required
    no response
